screen.sky_window.title: Sky Window Settings
screen.sky_window.mode_hint: Turn off to choose a fixed time and local weather. Turn on to restore the live sky.
screen.sky_window.appearance_hint: Changes the ceiling view only. World time, weather and room lighting stay unchanged.
message.sky_window.server_unavailable: The server does not support Sky Window settings.
message.sky_window.timeout: No server reply. Reopen the panel to check the saved settings.
sky_window.settings.error.reach: Move closer to the selected Sky Window.
sky_window.settings.error.unloaded: Load the entire connected ceiling and its neighboring chunks first.
sky_window.settings.error.missing: The selected Sky Window no longer exists.
sky_window.settings.error.too_large: This ceiling exceeds the 16,384-block limit. Split it into smaller sections.
sky_window.settings.error.cooldown: Please wait a moment before applying again.
